```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(easyNIS)
```

## Audit code frequencies

`nis_audit_code_transition()` summarizes named code groups by period. The
example is a small invented data frame; use separate calls for ICD-9 and
ICD-10 because the function matches only one code system at a time.

```{r audit}
toy <- data.frame(
  YEAR = rep(2018:2020, each = 2),
  I10_DX1 = c("I5022", "E119", "I509", "E119", "I5022", "E119"),
  DISCWT = rep(1, 6)
)
nis_audit_code_transition(
  toy,
  codes = c(heart_failure = "I50", diabetes = "E11"),
  type = "dx"
)
```

The output gives unweighted and weighted group counts and each group's share
of all discharges within the period. A year-over-year percentage change is
relative to the prior observed period; it is descriptive and does not explain
why coding prevalence changed.

## Compare diagnosis positions

Principal and secondary diagnoses can capture different presentations.
`nis_dx_sensitivity()` compares counts and selected outcome rates across
principal, secondary-only, and any-position definitions.

```{r sensitivity}
nis <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019))
nis_dx_sensitivity(nis, "I50")
```

The rows show how the synthetic definition changes with diagnosis position.
These are descriptive weighted summaries, not survey estimates with standard
errors. Use a survey design for inferential comparisons.

## Handle the ICD transition

NIS changed from ICD-9-CM to ICD-10-CM/PCS in October 2015. 2015 combines
ICD-9 discharges from Q1–Q3 with ICD-10 discharges from Q4. Flag the systems
separately using the appropriate slot names and version information; easyNIS
does not supply a crosswalk or clinical equivalence decisions. ICD-9 helpers
and code-system boundary checks are experimental.

## Common pitfalls

> **Common pitfalls**
>
> - A trend break can reflect code-set changes, case mix, or practice as well
>   as a true change in prevalence.
> - A zero in an audit means no match in the selected system, not absence in a
>   different code system.
> - Principal and any-position summaries are nested definitions, not
>   independent groups.

See [`nis_audit_code_transition()`](../reference/nis_audit_code_transition.html),
[`nis_dx_sensitivity()`](../reference/nis_dx_sensitivity.html), and
[`nis_flag_dx_position()`](../reference/nis_flag_dx_position.html).
